newsitem.title: CROATIA: Volume surges, rates flat at Croatia bill auction. [CORRECTED 12:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Volume surges, rates flat at Croatia bill auction. [CORRECTED 12:05 GMT]

text.p: Rates were steady and bill volume surged to 414 million kuna at Croatia's central bank weekly auction on Wednesday from last week's 128 million.
The 35-day rate stood at 7.5 percent as bank accepted all bids totalling 404 million kuna.
It also sold ten million kuna in 91-day bills with rate steady at 9.0 percent.
The banks stayed out of the longest-term 182-day bills which were last issued at 17.50 percent last year.
Reserve payments totalled 3.39 billion kuna (corrects from 39 billion), 7.9 million (corrects from 7.9 billion) higher than a forthnight ago.
